first.rationale: Promotional pricing most directly addresses the active SMB competitive threat and has inherited evidence of acquisition and revenue lift, but the summary does not establish durable qualified revenue, retention, or margin quality. Memory_86 is the strongest operational alternative given the onboarding decline, yet its summary only demonstrates early adoption. Verify both before committing; if pricing evidence does not support downstream cohort quality, favor onboarding simplification instead.

final.rationale: Run a controlled experiment shortening onboarding. The verified record shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing for this slot because its +18% qualified-revenue lift was offset by 30-day retention falling 12%, indicating poor renewal durability.
